title: Publish a Witness Practice Statement
statement: Publish a versioned practice statement defining exactly what a countersignature means.
verify: Document published and linked from the witness endpoint

title: WPS asserts receipt time
statement: The countersignature asserts the root was received at the stated time per the witness clock.

title: WPS asserts successor ordering
statement: The countersignature asserts the root is the immediate successor of the previous one for that operator.

title: WPS asserts retention
statement: The countersignature asserts the witness retained the root in its own append-only store.

title: WPS disclaims occurrence
statement: The statement disclaims any assertion that the underlying actions occurred.

title: WPS disclaims truthfulness
statement: The statement disclaims any assertion that recorded content is true.

title: WPS disclaims completeness
statement: The statement disclaims completeness and points to coverage attestation instead.

title: WPS disclaims lawfulness
statement: The statement disclaims any assertion that an action was lawful or authorised.

title: WPS versioned and anchored
statement: The practice statement is itself versioned and anchored like any other record.
source: WPS — versioned and anchored like everything else
verify: Statement root present in the witness log

title: Limitation of warranty
statement: Publish an explicit limitation of warranty for the witness service.
verify: Terms published and reviewed by counsel

title: FRE 902(13)/(14) technical shape
statement: Produce records whose integrity and generation process can be certified by a qualified person, matching the shape those rules contemplate.

title: eIDAS presumption only via qualified TSA
statement: Document that the Art. 41 presumption attaches only when anchored to a qualified TSA, and not via Tally's own witness.
verify: Documentation review; no contrary claim anywhere

title: Qualified TSA configurable
statement: A qualified TSA can be configured in the witness set by the operator.
source: Legal posture — the architecture is pluggable precisely so you can
verify: Live anchor against a qualified TSA

title: No conformity claims
statement: No product surface or marketing claims EU AI Act conformity.
verify: Claims audit across docs, site and UI

title: No certification of the customer
statement: Never certify the customer's compliance.
source: Legal posture — Tally does not certify you

title: Not-legal-advice disclaimer
statement: Carry a not-legal-advice disclaimer wherever statutes are cited.

title: Pursue qualified status
statement: Pursue accreditation for the hosted witness so the eIDAS presumption can attach.

title: Trademark clearance
statement: Complete a trademark search and clearance before the product name is fixed.
source: Draft banner — placeholder pending a trademark search
verify: Search report on file; mark filed

title: Apache-2.0 with patent grant
statement: Licence all open components under Apache-2.0.

title: DCO on contributions
statement: Require Signed-off-by on all contributions.
source: Licence and governance — contributions under DCO

title: Open component set
statement: Keep the spec, wire format, test vectors, practice statement and both collectors open.

title: Non-relicensing commitment
statement: Publish a commitment never to relicense the open components.
source: Licence and governance — we commit publicly

title: Third-party witnesses permitted
statement: Anyone, including competitors and hyperscalers, may run a conformant witness.
verify: No technical or licence barrier; third-party witness interoperates

title: Open conformance suite
statement: Publish the conformance suite so implementations can self-check.
verify: Suite in the repository under the open licence

title: Certification mark on passing
statement: Hold a certification mark and grant it on a passing conformance run.
source: Licence and governance — control the badge

title: Witness list by pull request
statement: Accept witness-list entries by pull request.
source: Licence and governance — arrive by pull request

title: No gatekeeping of the witness list
statement: Do not vet, rank, or charge for inclusion in the witness list.
source: Licence and governance — open data, not a gate
verify: Policy published; list contains entries not controlled by us

title: Bounty: one class, one payout
statement: Pay once per tamper class, not per instance.

title: Bounty: default configuration only
statement: Findings must survive the shipped default configuration.
verify: Terms published; default config documented and pinned

title: Bounty: scope binding both ways
statement: The published threat model binds the programme; exclusions cannot be added after a report.
verify: Terms published; change log on the threat model

title: Bounty: annual cap
statement: Cap payouts at EUR 50,000 per calendar year, continuing to publish and credit beyond it.

title: Bounty: first reporter wins
statement: Award the first complete report.

title: Bounty: external arbiter
statement: Novelty is decided by a named arbiter from the transparency-log community who is not employed by us.
verify: Arbiter named in the repository; dispute path documented

title: Published review history
statement: Maintain a public record of what was added, cut and rewritten across revisions.
verify: Section present and updated per revision

title: Witness SLA
statement: Offer an independent non-hyperscaler countersignature with a service level agreement.

title: Queue drain and retry
statement: Drain and re-submit queued unwitnessed batches with backoff once a witness returns.

title: Self-hosted witness deployment guide
statement: Document running the witness under internal audit with keys in their custody.
verify: Guide published; followed end to end in a clean environment

title: Separation-of-duties guidance
statement: Document the key-custody split between engineering and internal audit.

title: Zero-egress mode
statement: Support and verify a deployment with no account, no enrolment with us, and no traffic leaving the perimeter.
source: Deployment — no traffic leaving your perimeter
verify: Egress capture in a fully self-hosted deployment

title: C2SP conformance
statement: Conform to the C2SP tlog-witness checkpoint specification.
verify: Conformance suite against the published spec

title: Verify third-party countersignatures
statement: The verifier accepts countersignatures from witnesses we do not operate.
source: Proof — a verifier with a different policy
verify: Verify a pack anchored only to Rekor and a third-party TSA

title: Documented evidence pack format
statement: Publish and version the evidence pack format so third parties can write verifiers.
source: Proof; Licence and governance — wire format open
verify: Spec published; independent verifier implementation validates a pack

title: Additive OMA integration
statement: Integrate with OMA without a fork, patch or upstream pull request.
verify: Install against unmodified upstream at the supported version

title: Framework-agnostic capture
statement: Capture works for any stack speaking MCP, including runtimes with no journal.
source: Capture — including runtimes that ship no journal at all
verify: E2E against two non-OMA agent runtimes

title: Reuse rather than reimplement
statement: Build on Sigstore, Rekor, Trillian and C2SP rather than reimplementing their roles.
source: Credit; Independence — we did not invent a protocol
verify: Dependency review; no bespoke transparency log

title: No blocking or gating
statement: MUST NOT block, gate or filter agent actions.
verify: Code review; no enforcement path exists

title: No tamper-proof claim
statement: MUST NOT describe the product as tamper-proof.

title: No compliance certification
statement: MUST NOT issue or imply a compliance certificate.

title: Not an observability platform
statement: MUST NOT position as a replacement for traces, SIEM or dashboards.

title: No reviewer UI in OSS
statement: MUST NOT include a reviewer surface in the open-source release.
source: Scope — belongs to the operated control plane

title: No SSO in OSS
statement: MUST NOT include SSO in the open-source release.

title: No RBAC in OSS
statement: MUST NOT include RBAC in the open-source release.

title: No multi-tenancy in OSS
statement: MUST NOT include multi-tenancy in the open-source release.

title: No retention tiers in OSS
statement: MUST NOT include retention tiers in the open-source release.

title: No verifiable delay function
statement: MUST NOT ship a VDF.

title: No ZK compliance proofs
statement: MUST NOT ship zero-knowledge compliance proofs, and MUST NOT place them on the roadmap.

title: No TEE suppression claim
statement: MUST NOT claim a TEE makes event suppression impossible.

title: No blockchain as ledger
statement: MUST NOT use a blockchain as the primary ledger; a public chain may serve only as the optional hard anchor.

title: No self-scored defeat metric
statement: MUST NOT publish an N-of-N attacks-defeated score.
source: Attack class section — we deliberately publish no score

title: Hard anchor off by default
statement: The trust-minimised hard anchor MUST default to disabled.
source: Independence — optional and off by default

title: Public red-team suite
statement: Maintain a public tamper suite reproducible in two commands.
source: Why — the suite is public and runs in two commands

title: Threat model document
statement: Publish the threat model as a maintained document.

title: Considered-and-rejected rationale
statement: Publish rejected designs with reasons.
verify: Section present; updated as decisions are made

title: Label targets as targets
statement: Any unverified figure is labelled a target, not a measurement, until benchmarked.

title: Publish honest limits
statement: Publish the known information leaks and the attacks not covered.
source: Disclosure — the honest limit; Threat model — out of scope

title: Upstream attribution
statement: Credit OMA, Sigstore, Rekor, Trillian, C2SP and Schneier–Kelsey.
verify: Attribution present in README and NOTICE

title: Document the two-policy split
statement: Document that the witness list governs who is asked and the acceptance policy governs who is accepted.
source: Getting started — separate files on purpose
verify: Documentation review; worked example for both

title: Publish bounty terms
statement: Publish the full bounty terms alongside the offer.
verify: Terms published before the offer goes live

title: Bilateral receipts
statement: Have the counterparty co-sign a receipt so a record exists outside the operator.
verify: Reference counterparty implementation co-signs via the MCP proxy

title: HTTP egress collector
statement: Capture consequential actions taken over outbound HTTP.
verify: E2E capture of an outbound call

title: Shell collector
statement: Capture consequential shell actions.
verify: E2E capture of a shell invocation

title: Database-write collector
statement: Capture consequential database writes.

title: Reviewer surface
statement: Provide the approval review surface OMA leaves unbuilt.

title: SSO
statement: Provide SSO in the operated plane.

title: RBAC
statement: Provide RBAC in the operated plane.

title: Multi-tenancy
statement: Provide tenant isolation in the operated plane.

title: Retention tiers
statement: Provide retention tiers in the operated plane.

title: Evidence export
statement: Provide regulator-ready evidence export in the operated plane.

title: Every requirement traces to a promise
statement: Each requirement names the release-notes section that promises it; orphans are rejected.
verify: Validator fails on a missing source

title: Every requirement has a verification method
statement: Each requirement names how it will be verified.
verify: Validator fails on a missing verify field

title: Red-team canary in CI
statement: The tamper suite runs in CI and fails the build when an observation changes.
verify: CI job present and failing on drift

title: Benchmark before claiming
statement: No performance figure is published as fact until its benchmark exists and passes.
source: Numbers we are signing up to; footer
verify: Release gate blocks on missing benchmark

title: Claims audit per release
statement: Run a claims audit against the scope guards before each release.
verify: Checklist completed and signed off per release
